title: Open covering families of moduli substacks
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], with universes as in [def-weil-size-convention], and let $\mathcal F$ be a category over $\mathit{Sch}/S$ with the functors, discrete representable groupoids and $2$-fibre products of [def-sfb-stable-pointed-moduli-groupoids]. Let $I$ be any set and let $(\mathcal U_i)_{i\in I}$ be full open substacks of $\mathcal F$ [def-sfb-open-moduli-substack]. Define this family to be an open cover when, for every scheme $T$ over $S$, every functor $t:h_T\to\mathcal F$ over $\mathit{Sch}/S$, and every point $x\in T$, there are an index $i\in I$, a scheme $W$ over $S$, an open immersion $j:W\to T$ [def-weil-open-immersion], and an equivalence $h_W\simeq h_T\times_{\mathcal F}\mathcal U_i$ over $h_T$, identifying its first projection with $h_j$, such that $x=j(w)$ for some $w\in W$. Thus the open inverse images of these particular substacks cover every scheme test. The indexing universe and the category object and morphism universes are independently variable; empty indexing sets and empty schemes are allowed.
